newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks stuck in low liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks stuck in low liquidity.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks were almost static in early Tuesday trade as buyers were stymied by low liquidity, brokers said.
The all share index was 1.88 points higher at 609.92 at the mid-morning break, on turnover of 6.4 million rupees.
"There is buying interest in stocks at both ends of the price scale, but sellers are pulling back," said a broker who declined to be identified.
Banking, manufacturing, conglomerates and plantations, were the four areas being focused on, he added.
